headline: Brazilian Crypto Exchange Mercado Bitcoin Halts Withdrawals
summary: Brazilian crypto exchange Mercado Bitcoin suspended deposits and withdrawals on November 2, with a security firm estimating losses exceeding $40 million.
why: Mercado Bitcoin is a major cryptocurrency platform in Brazil, making liquidity suspensions and security breaches critical events for regional digital asset market confidence.

impacts.name: Bitcoin
impacts.why: Exchange suspensions can create localized panic and liquidity concerns.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h
